title: Stability & Polish Update
headline: Eliminated UAC flash on power plan setup, fixed startup polling before login, and corrected the installed app name.
changes: Fixed power plan setup flashing a UAC prompt for users already running as administrator
Prevented dashboard intelligence polling from firing before login completes
Fixed issue detection scan triggering on page load before authentication resolved
Fixed display signal graph polling protected endpoints before login
Installed app name now permanently displays as Switchcontrol with no version suffix
Added page-active hook infrastructure for smarter background job lifecycle
